name: Banh trang nuoc dua
summary: Coconut rice cracker from Tam Quan. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says coconut milk goes into the rice batter, and that the cracker is grilled, not eaten soft. The city tourism introduction names it and does not describe it.
origin: Thị trấn Tam Quan, thị xã Hoài Nhơn.
taste: The portal says the coconut milk makes it fragrant and rich.
howToEat: Grill it. The portal says it can be eaten with other dishes and does not name them.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Tam Quan, Hoài Nhơn. Not a stall the city page places on a Quy Nhon street.
seoTitle: Banh trang nuoc dua — Tam Quan coconut cracker
seoDescription: Bánh tráng nước dừa is a Tam Quan rice cracker made with coconut milk and eaten grilled. The provincial portal names no Quy Nhon stall. Check on arrival.
